question: Should ClawHub adopt an upload-first empty state for first-arrival skill and plugin publishing, hiding plugin metadata fields until files are selected?
rationale: This is a user-facing publish UX direction rather than a defined bug fix, so a maintainer should confirm the intended product behavior after the correctness and proof blockers are handled.

options.title: Approve upload-first after blockers
options.body: Accept the UX direction once the branch preserves staged publish status handling, resolves conflicts, and includes real browser proof.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Ask the contributor to limit the change to one publishing surface or keep metadata visible where maintainers want the existing workflow.

options.title: Keep current forms
options.body: Reject the upload-first direction and keep the existing always-visible publish forms.

recommendation.title: Approve upload-first after blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the UX direction once the branch preserves staged publish status handling, resolves conflicts, and includes real browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current publish-flow implementation and staged prepublication behavior that this UX change must preserve.
